Kielbasa With Sauce
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, January 2, 2010 - 12:09am

Ingredients




1 jar Durkee's Famous Sauce
Mrs. Butterworth's maple syrup (fill jar once)
2 kielbasa

Preparation

1 Boil kielbasa. Mix other ingredients in crock pot. Remove kielbasa after boiled, slice and add to mixture. Let sit. Stir and serve from crock pot.
